title: Introducing Instant Inheritance
summary: Sunset now moves a deceased person's bank balance into the estate account in a few business days, with no branch visit and no paperwork.
body_markdown:
Thank you for visiting our website. If you’ve lost a friend or family member, we hope our tool provides some assistance during a difficult time.


Our mission at Sunset is to make it easy to find and transfer every account and asset after a loss.


Estate bank accounts are held in FDIC-insured sweep accounts with up to $3m in coverage, and are always accessible to users to pay bills or distribute to heirs. Sunset's software is designed to help families manage estate funds efficiently and with a focus on low risk. However, as with all financial accounts, even FDIC-insured bank accounts involve certain inherent risks.


Sunset is completely free for families. We only charge a fee for professional users. If anyone claims to represent or work for Sunset and asks you for payment, this is fraudulent. Please report it immediately to[\[email protected\]](https://www.hellosunset.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#432f2624222f032b262f2f2c30362d3026376d202c2e) .


We work hard to be thorough, but no search is perfect. Some assets may not be found and results may sometimes have errors.


By using this website or our software, you acknowledge that the information provided is for informational purposes only and agree to our[Terms of Use](https://www.hellosunset.com/terms-of-use) and[Privacy Policy](https://www.hellosunset.com/privacy-policy) .
